description: Bridge OnaBasin is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Africa GeoPortal. This model present an integrated flood risk analysis for Ona river basin in the western part of Ibadan City, Nigeria. It shows the magnitude of risk and the validation data using past flood inventory layer. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher Africa GeoPortal. Its tags are Ona river basin, Flood Risk, Ibadan, Nigeria. The portal shows 2022-08-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
